messages:
ops-oncall: Alert: we're seeing a spike of 500/504 + client timeouts for hosted inference in eu-west starting ~12:14 UTC. Error rate ~12% for /v1/generate and websocket streams. Opening war room — paging SRE and Runtime.
prod-support: getting multiple customer escalations, 3 accounts reported bulk failures. Customers see requests hang then 502. Need ETA + mitigation.
sre-lead: acknowledged. Collecting traces and tailing gateway logs now. Which deploys went out to eu-west in last 2 hours?
deploy-bot: deploy finished: service/runtime-canary v2.9.1 -> eu-west at 11:58 UTC (id: dpl-20260301-778). No related deploys to edge-gateway.
eng-runtime: looking at runtime traces: increased tail latency on batcher hot-path, lots of KV cache misses, memory pressure on a subset of pods. 5xx appears originated upstream of gateway in inference workers.
eng-batcher: we rolled canary for adaptive-batching heuristics yesterday. Canary config increased max-batch-latency to 200ms and enabled pack-forward optimization. Canary traffic was small but looks like it hit a particular hardware pool. Investigating queue growth.
sre-lead: immediate mitigation options: a) rollback runtime canary b) shift some traffic to dedicated pool c) raise instance count for eu-west. Which is fastest?
eng-batcher: fastest is rollback canary. We can flip canary flag in ~3min. Backup plan: scale up worker pool, but autoscaler has cooldown.
ops-oncall: rolling rollback now (flip flag + restart canary pods). I'll monitor metrics.
eng-runtime: adding temporary circuit-breaker to gateway routing to fail fast to fallback model variant — can push rule in ~10min.
prod-support: telling impacted customers we have mitigation in progress, will follow up with RCA.
ops-oncall: rollback applied — canary pods draining. Error rate dropping from 12% -> 6% in 4m. Continuing to watch.
customer-ops: one customer reports partial recovery, some users still hit timeouts. Any idea if sessions are stuck?
eng-runtime: sessions using older kv-cache entries may be experiencing longer retries. We're purging some KV cache entries on problematic hosts.
sre-lead: after rollback, we still see intermittent 504s from a small subset of hosts. Suspect hardware-specific perf regression when pack-forward interacts with that GPU runtime. Eng-runtime to validate.
eng-runtime: confirmed — two hosts (host-22 and host-27) show memory thrash and high context switch rate. Evicting pods and cordoning hosts.
ops-oncall: evictions done; traffic rerouted off host-22/27. 5xx now ~0.7%. Marking incident as mitigated.
prod-support: sending customer update: mitigated, postmortem and credits will follow.
sre-lead: postmortem follow-up items (initial list):
- ACTION ENG-BATCHER: revert adaptive pack-forward change from canary and add a staged rollout with host-level safety checks (owner: eng-batcher, due: 2026-03-04).
- ACTION ENG-RUNTIME: add host-level memory pressure alert + automated pod eviction threshold (owner: eng-runtime, due: 2026-03-05).
- ACTION SRE: add a smoke check that routes a small sample of canary traffic across a broader host set before enabling pack-forward (owner: sre-lead, due: 2026-03-06).
- ACTION DOCS: update runbook to include steps for this specific 5xx pattern and KB for customer comms template (owner: docs, due: 2026-03-07).
- ACTION PROD-SUPPORT: prepare templated customer credit/communication and list of affected accounts for outreach (owner: prod-support, due: 2026-03-03).
eng-batcher: agree with action items. We'll add extra telemetry for per-host batch latency and a safety gate to prevent enabling pack-forward if any host shows >25% queue growth.
eng-runtime: will instrument KV cache miss rates and expose per-host memory/ctxswitch metrics to Grafana. Also will create a test harness to repro pack-forward on smaller GPU types.
sre-lead: we should also add a soft-fallback in routing: if worker 5xx > 5% for 5m, shift 10% of traffic to lower-cost fallback models automatically. Eng-runtime can prototype.
eng-runtime: noted, will prototype fallback routing rule.
prod-support: agreed on customer messaging cadence. I'll draft the update and share.
ops-oncall: closing war room for now — mitigation stable. Filing incident ticket and linking this thread to the postmortem doc.
docs: will create postmortem doc draft, include timeline, root cause hypothesis, and action item owners. I'll ping for reviews by EOD. :memo:
sre-lead: thanks everyone. Good catch on rollback speed. We'll reconvene if any regression. :thumbsup:
